implementation.scope: All 85 shared-book Marine identities are represented in runtime and selectable through the consolidated local catalog; the Dark Angels App Land Speeder Vengeance has a distinct source-linked runtime profile whose pending local checks keep it out of new construction choices. Wardens of Ultramar has individual model characteristics, source-listed weapons, Support, Combat Doctrines, Raise the Banner and Strategium Command; focused local checks passed. Land Speeder Vengeance has its source profile, weapon option, Storm of Vengeance reaction and Nightforged Battery re-roll decisions implemented with local checks pending; it remains excluded from new construction choices until those checks pass. Gauntlet Task Force implements Storm and Secure at Movement-phase end through the shared secure-objective path and Duty is Never Done at Fight-phase end through transport capacity and whole-unit range checks. Aggressive Disembarkation offers a 1 CP relaxed-placement option for supported Movement-phase disembark choices and before Emergency Disembark Hazard rolls. Emergency placement relaxes only the wholly-within range and retains as-close-as-possible placement, engagement fallback, Battle-shock, the no-Charge restriction and the active-player placement handoff. Before each mandatory Drop Pod Assault Rapid Disembark, the stratagem offers the same choice after arrival, including after Rapid Ingress during the opponent's Movement phase; the more-than-8-inch enemy restriction remains. Other out-of-phase selection contexts are not implemented. Phobos Shadow Force now exposes Shadow Masters (preserve Hidden eligibility after shooting or make a D6-inch Normal Move that blocks Charge until turn end), Strike from the Shadows (1 CP; hidden PHOBOS attacks gain +1 Strength and Lethal Hits), Tactical Withdrawal (1 CP; an unengaged PHOBOS or SCOUT SQUAD unit enters Strategic Reserves at the end of the opponent's Fight phase), and Mortis Snares (1 CP at Movement-phase end; arm each objective controlled by an eligible unit, then roll when an enemy move ends within range; on 2+, apply D6 mortal wounds through the shared allocation path). Shadow Masters currently covers the owner's Shooting phase; out-of-phase shooting remains pending. Venator Omni-auspex for Phobos Shadow Force is selectable for four export-linked PHOBOS bearers and uses the shared hidden-target Wound rerolls; Execute and Redeploy is selectable for four export-linked PHOBOS bearers and offers an unengaged Normal Move up to 6 inches after shooting, blocking Charge until turn end; it honors the one-Normal-Move-per-phase limit. All components listed on the current Phobos Shadow Force page now have bounded local paths. Shadow Masters remains limited to the owner's Shooting phase; focused local checks remain pending. Network validation remains deferred and full faction/army legality remains uncertified.

detachment_rule.name: Templar Vows
detachment_rule.summary: At the start of the first battle round, choose one Vow for friendly Adeptus Astartes units until battle end: attacks against Psykers gain Precision and Lance; attacks against units with higher Toughness than the attacker's Strength gain +1 to Wound; or Infantry securing an objective secures it and can Advance without losing action-start eligibility.
detachment_rule.restrictions: Army may include Black Templars units but no Adeptus Astartes units from other Chapters.
detachment_rule.implemented_scope: All three Templar Vows are offered at the start of battle round 1. Abhor the Witch adds Precision and Lance to current-reference Adeptus Astartes melee attacks against PSYKER targets. Accept Any Challenge adds +1 to Wound when target Toughness exceeds attack Strength. Uphold secures objectives controlled by current-reference Adeptus Astartes Infantry and permits those units to start otherwise eligible actions after Advancing. Consecrating Aura (20 points) is selectable for 23 export-linked current-catalog bearer profiles and grants a 5+ invulnerable save to the bearer's unit, preserving better existing saves. Incendiary Animus (25 points) is selectable for five export-linked Chaplain or Judiciar profiles and grants +1 Strength to the bearer's unit's melee attacks. Zealous Vanguard (25 points) is selectable for 23 export-linked current-catalog bearer profiles and grants Scouts 6 to the enhanced unit through the shared pre-battle move and Strategic Reserves set-up flow. Augury Servo-host (20 points) is selectable for 23 export-linked current-catalog bearers; in the Shooting phase, the enhanced unit selects one visible enemy within 18 inches and that target cannot benefit from cover for the phase. Pious Enmity (1 CP) is available when a friendly Chaplain or Judiciar unit is selected to fight; choose melee Hit rerolls of 1, or Hit and Wound rerolls of 1 against MONSTER/VEHICLE targets. For the Emperor's Honour! (1 CP) is available when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit is selected to fight in either player's Fight phase; its melee attacks gain Precision for that phase. Requires current unit abilities and Black Templars Chapter context.

stratagems.name: Aggressive Disembarkation
stratagems.timing: Any phase, when an embarked friendly Astartes unit is selected to move.
stratagems.effect_summary: During that move, each model can be set up within the Transport's set-up distance instead of wholly within that distance.
stratagems.implementation_scope: The stratagem is offered with currently supported Movement-phase disembark choices for an embarked friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. Each model may be set up within, rather than wholly within, the selected mode's set-up distance: 3 inches for Rapid, Tactical, Assault and Shock, or 6 inches for Combat. Tactical-mode eligibility also accounts for the relaxed placement range. Mode, Engagement Range, coherency, Hazard, ingress and post-move restrictions remain enforced. Other stratagem gates retain CP discounts, once-per-phase use and one use per target unit. Emergency Disembark now offers the stratagem before Hazard rolls and permits setup within 6 inches instead of wholly within, while preserving as-close-as-possible placement, engagement fallback, Battle-shock and the no-Charge restriction. The existing active-player placement handoff remains. Before each mandatory Drop Pod Assault Rapid Disembark, the stratagem offers the same choice after arrival, including after Rapid Ingress during the opponent's Movement phase; the more-than-8-inch enemy restriction remains. Other out-of-phase selection contexts are not implemented.

third_party_comparison_review.purpose: Sample its current public Space Marines pages as an additional discrepancy detector; this is not rules certification.

findings.provider_values: T4; 5/10 models cost 80/150 points; Objective Secured and Hail of Bolts.
findings.current_reference_values: T5; 5/10 models cost 85/170 points; Bolter Discipline and Tactical Mainstay.
findings.assessment: Material mismatch in characteristics, points and ability set. Do not use provider values for current roster or runtime data.

findings.provider_values: T4; chainsword S4; 5/10 models cost 75/150 points; Targeted Intercession rerolls Wound rolls against a selected target, with a stronger reroll near objectives.
findings.current_reference_values: T5; chainsword S5; 5/10 models cost 85/170 points; after a charge, melee attacks gain +1 Strength and +1 AP.
findings.assessment: Material mismatch in characteristics, weapon profile, points and ability effect. The shared ability name does not indicate shared mechanics.

findings.provider_values: T6; 5/10 models cost 100/200 points; Unyielding in the Face of the Foe grants +1 to armour saving throws against Damage 1 attacks while within range of an objective controlled by the player.
findings.current_reference_values: T6; 5/10 models cost 115/230 points; while controlling an objective, the unit has +1 to save rolls.
findings.assessment: Material mismatch in points and ability trigger/effect wording. Similar phrasing must not be treated as the same mechanic.

findings.provider_values: T5; 5/10 models cost 160/320 points; Storm Bolter S4/AP0; Fury of the First adds 1 to Hit rolls against the Oath of Moment target; Teleport Homer uses 0CP and an 8-inch enemy exclusion.
findings.current_reference_values: T6; 5/10 models cost 190/380 points; Storm Bolter S5/AP-1; Fury of the First adds 1 AP against units within 9 inches; Teleport Homer modifies Rapid Ingress cost and uses a 9-inch enemy exclusion.
findings.assessment: Material mismatch across profile, weapon, points and abilities, including an older Oath-linked rule.

third_party_comparison_review.conclusion: The sampled 40k.app Space Marines pages lag current Codex-era e11 reference content in multiple fields. Keep the app as a candidate discovery and discrepancy surface only; verify each rule/profile against the current requested e11 reference and applicable official GW source before catalog admission. Do not import or use these sampled values for gameplay.
